body.text: Kaṭhina-v 1. buddho bhagavāṃ śrāvastyāṃ varṣā upagato jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme / tena khalu samayena saṃbahulā bhikṣavaḥ sākete varṣopagatās trayāṇāṃ vārṣikāṇāṃ māsānām atyayāt kṛtacīvarā niṣṭhitacīvarāḥ samādāya pātracīvaraṃ bahutṛṇe bahukardame uṣṇena klāmyantaḥ svedaparyākulīkṛtaśarīrā yena śrāvastīṃ tena cārikāṃ caranta

children.text: śrāvastīm anuprāptāḥ atha saṃbahulā bhikṣavaḥ pātracīvaraṃ pratiśamayya pādau prakṣālya yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntā upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣaṇṇāḥ
children.translated_text: they arrived at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Then those many <s>bhikṣus</s>, having put away their bowls and robes and having washed their feet, approached the Blessed One. Having approached and having venerated the feet of the Blessed One with their heads, they sat down to one side.

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 1. The <s>Buddha</s>, the Blessed One, spent the rains at <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jetavana</s>, the park of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>. At that time, a large number of <s>bhikṣus</s> had spent the rains at <s>Sāketa</s>. After the passage of three months of the rainy season, having made their robes and completed their robes, taking up their bowls and robes, through much grass and much mud, being exhausted by heat, their bodies drenched with sweat, wandering on a journey through the countryside —

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 2. dharmatā khalu buddhā bhagavanta āgantukān bhikṣūn anayā pratisaṃmodanayā pratisaṃmoda

children.text: te / kuto yūyaṃ bhikṣava etarhy āgacchata : kutra vā stha varṣā uṣitā iti pratisaṃmodate bhagavān āgantukān bhikṣūn anayā pratisaṃmodanayā sukhaṃ sparśaṃ varṣā nayā kuto yūyaṃ bhikṣava etarhy āgacchatha kutra vā stha varṣā uṣitāḥ te kathayaṃti sāketād vayaṃ bhadant'; etarhy āgacchāma sākete vā sma varṣā uṣitāḥ kaccid yūyaṃ bhikṣavaḥ sākete sukhaṃ sparśaṃ varṣā uṣitā na vā stha klāntāḥ piṇḍakena tathyaṃ vayaṃ bhadanta (
children.translated_text: they greet: 'Where do you <s>bhikṣus</s> come from now? Where did you spend the rains?' The Blessed One greeted the visiting <s>bhikṣus</s> with this greeting: 'Did you spend the rains comfortably? Where do you <s>bhikṣus</s> come from now? Where did you spend the rains?' They said: 'We come now from <s>Sāketa</s>, venerable sir. We spent the rains at <s>Sāketa</s>.' 'Did you, <s>bhikṣus</s>, spend the rains comfortably at <s>Sāketa</s>? Were you not wearied by alms-rounds?' 'Truly, venerable sir, (

children.text: ) sāketa sukhaṃ sparśaṃ varṣā uṣitā na vā sma
children.translated_text: ) we spent the rains comfortably at <s>Sāketa</s>, nor were we

children.text: piṇḍakenāpi tu vayaṃ samādāya pātracīvaraṃ bahutṛṇe bahukardame uṣṇena klāmyanta
children.translated_text: by alms-rounds. But we, having taken up our bowls and robes, through much grass and much mud, being exhausted by heat,
our bodies drenched with sweat, wandering on a journey through the countryside, arrived here with difficulty.'

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 2. It is indeed the natural practice that <s>Buddha</s>s, Blessed Ones, greet visiting <s>bhikṣus</s> with this greeting —

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 3. bhagavān saṃlakṣayati / klāmyanti bata me śrāvakāḥ samādāya pātracīvaraṃ bahutṛṇe bahukardame uṣṇena klāmyanti svedaparyākulīkṛtaśarīrā janapadacārikāṃ caranto yanv ahaṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ sparśavihārārthaṃ dātrīṇāṃ ca deyadharmaparibhogārthaṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ kaṭhinam anujānīyaṃ / yasmāt paṃcānuśaṃsā

children.text: kaṭhināstare na daśāhaparamaṃ na māsaparamaṃ na rātri
children.translated_text: of the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreading: no ten-day limit, no one-month limit, no overnight
separation [from robes], setting out on a journey through the countryside with an inner and outer robe (
) setting out, and as much as
wearing of distributed robes as one wishes.' And there are also five [more] advantages

children.text: ) paraṃparabhojanaṃ na kuleṣv ānimantritacārikā yāvadāptaṃ cīvaraparyeṣaṇaṃ (
children.translated_text: ) successive dining, no [restriction on] uninvited visiting of families, seeking robes as much as one wishes (

children.text: ) kārtikān māsād yāvat phālguno māso atrāntarāt sāstṛtakaṭhi
children.translated_text: ) from the month of <s>Kārttika</s> until the month of <s>Phālguna</s> — during this interval, those who have spread the <s>kaṭhina</s>

children.text: nāṃ lābha iti viditvā bhikṣūn āmantrayate sma / tasmāt tarhi bhikṣavo 'nujānāmi bhikṣūṇāṃ sparśavihārārthaṃ dātrīṇāṃ ca deyadharmaparibhogārthaṃ varṣoṣitair bhikṣubhiḥ kaṭhinam āstartavyaṃ yasmāt paṃcānuśaṃsā
children.translated_text: obtain [these privileges].' Having understood this, he addressed the <s>bhikṣus</s>: 'Therefore, <s>bhikṣus</s>, I permit: for the sake of comfortable dwelling of the <s>bhikṣus</s> and for the donors' enjoyment of their gifts, the <s>kaṭhina</s> is to be spread by <s>bhikṣus</s> who have spent the rains. For there are five advantages

children.text: kaṭhine na daśāhaparamaṃ pūrvavad yāvad āstṛtakaṭhinānāṃ lābha iti
children.translated_text: of the <s>kaṭhina</s>: no ten-day limit — as before, up to: this is the benefit of those who have spread the <s>kaṭhina</s>.'

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 3. The Blessed One reflected: 'Alas, my disciples are exhausted! Having taken up their bowls and robes, through much grass and much mud, they are exhausted by heat, their bodies drenched with sweat, wandering on a journey through the countryside. Suppose I were to permit the <s>kaṭhina</s> (robe-spreading ceremony) for the <s>bhikṣus</s>, for the sake of comfortable dwelling and for the donors' enjoyment of their gifts. For there are five advantages

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 4. uktaṃ bhagavatā kaṭhinam āstartavyam iti bhikṣavo na jānate katham (

children.text: ) āstartavyam iti / bhagavān āha / yad varṣoṣitasya saṃghasya cīvaralābhaḥ saṃpadyate tasmād āstartavyaṃ evaṃ ca punar āstartavyaṃ pūrvavat* sāmagryam ārocayitavyaṃ idaṃ cīvaraṃ varṣoṣitasya saṃghasya cīvaralābhaḥ saṃpannaḥ yadi saṃghasyābhirucitam anena cīvareṇa saṃghasya kaṭhinam (
children.translated_text: ) it should be spread. The Blessed One said: 'When a robe-acquisition accrues to the <s>Saṃgha</s> that has spent the rains, from that [robe] it should be spread. And it should be spread thus: first, the agreement should be announced: "This robe is the robe-acquisition that has accrued to the <s>Saṃgha</s> that has spent the rains. If it pleases the <s>Saṃgha</s>, with this robe the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s> (

children.text: ) āstariṣyati / tataḥ paścād aparasmin divase śayanāsanaprajñaptiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍīm ākoṭya pṛṣtavācikayā bhikṣūṃ (
children.translated_text: ) will be spread." Thereafter, on the following day, having arranged the seats, having struck the bell, [having summoned] the <s>bhikṣus</s> by roll-call (

children.text: ) samanuyujya sarvasaṃghe sanniṣaṇṇe sannipatite ekena bhikṣuṇā jñaptiṃ kṛtvā karma kartavya
children.translated_text: ) having assembled [them], when the entire <s>Saṃgha</s> is seated and assembled, a motion having been made by one <s>bhikṣu</s>, the formal act is to be performed:

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 4. The Blessed One said the <s>kaṭhina</s> should be spread, but the <s>bhikṣus</s> did not know how (

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 5. śṛṇotu bhadantāḥ saṃgha idaṃ cīvaraṃ varṣoṣitasya saṃghasya cīvaralābhaḥ saṃpannaḥ saṃghasya kaṭhinam abhirucitaṃ anena cīvareṇa kaṭhinam āstarituṃ / yenāstīrṇakaṭhinād āvāsāt prakrāmantaḥ (

children.text: ) purāṇacīvarāṇāṃ apy avipravāso bhaviṣyati prāg eva navakānāṃ sacet saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ kṣametānujānīyāt saṃgho yat saṃghaḥ idaṃ cīvaraṃ kaṭhinārthaṃ saṃmanyetānena cīvareṇa saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstariṣyati yenāstīrṇakaṭhinād āvāsāt* prakrāmantaḥ purāṇacīvarāṇām apy avipravāso bhaviṣyati prāg eva navakānām ity eṣā jñaptiḥ // evaṃ ca karma kartavyaṃ
children.translated_text: ) even old robes will not be lost, how much less new ones. If it is the right time and the <s>Saṃgha</s> approves, may the <s>Saṃgha</s> consent that it approve this robe for the purpose of <s>kaṭhina</s>. With this robe the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s> will be spread. For those departing from a residence where the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been spread, even old robes will not be lost, how much less new ones.' This is the motion. And the formal act is to be performed thus:

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 5. 'Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> hear. This robe is the robe-acquisition that has accrued to the <s>Saṃgha</s> that has spent the rains. It has pleased the <s>Saṃgha</s> to make the <s>kaṭhina</s> with this robe. With this robe the <s>kaṭhina</s> will be spread. For those departing from a residence where the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been spread (

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 6. śṛṇotu bhadantāḥ saṃgha idaṃ cīvaraṃ varṣoṣitasya saṃghasya cīvaralābhaḥ saṃpannaḥ saṃghasya cābhirucitaṃ kaṭhinaṃ kartuṃ tat saṃgha idaṃ cīvaraṃ kaṭhinārthaṃ saṃmanyate anena cīvareṇa saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstariṣyati yenāstīrṇakaṭhinād āvāsāt prakrāmataḥ purāṇacīvarakāṇām apy avipravāso bhaviṣyati prāg eva navakānāṃ (

children.text: ) yeṣām āyuṣmatāṃ kṣamate idaṃ cīvaraṃ kaṭhinārthaṃ saṃmantum anena cīvareṇa saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstariṣyati yenāstīrṇakaṭhinād āvāsāt prakramata
children.translated_text: ) Those venerable ones who approve of approving this robe for the purpose of <s>kaṭhina</s> — with this robe the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s> will be spread. For those departing from a residence where the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been spread,

children.text: purāṇacīvarakāṇām apy avipravāso bhaviṣyati prāg eva navakānāṃ sa tūṣṇīṃ na kṣamate bhāṣantāṃ saṃmataḥ saṃghena idaṃ cīvaraṃ kaṭhinārtham anena cīvareṇa
children.translated_text: even old robes will not be lost, how much less new ones — let them remain silent. Those who do not approve, let them speak.' It is approved by the <s>Saṃgha</s>. This robe is for the purpose of <s>kaṭhina</s>. With this robe

children.text: kaṭhinam āstariṣyati yenāstīrṇakaṭhinād āvāsāt* prakrāmataḥ purāṇacīvarakāṇām apy avipravāso bhaviṣyati prāg eva navakānāṃ kṣāntam anujñātaṃ saṃghena yasmāt tūṣṇīṃ evam etad dhārayāmi
children.translated_text: <s>kaṭhina</s> will be spread. For those departing from a residence where the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been spread, even old robes will not be lost, how much less new ones. It is approved and consented to by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, since they remain silent. Thus I understand it.

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 6. 'Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> hear. This robe is the robe-acquisition that has accrued to the <s>Saṃgha</s> that has spent the rains. And it has pleased the <s>Saṃgha</s> to make the <s>kaṭhina</s>. The <s>Saṃgha</s> approves this robe for the purpose of <s>kaṭhina</s>. With this robe the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s> will be spread. For those departing from a residence where the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been spread, even old robes will not be lost, how much less new ones (

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 7. tataḥ paścāt kaṭhināstārako bhikṣuḥ saṃmantavyaḥ paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgataḥ kaṭhināstārako bhikṣur asaṃmato na saṃmantavyaḥ saṃmataś cāvakāśayitavyaḥ katamaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ avarṣiko varṣachinnakaḥ (

children.text: ) paścimakāṃ varṣām upagato anyatra varṣoṣitaḥ śikṣādattakaḥ apare api paṃca na saṃmantavyāḥ pārivāsika mūlapārivāsika mānāpya mūlamānāpyacāra utkṣiptakaḥ apare paṃca na saṃmantavyā cchandād gacchati dveṣāṃ mohād bhayād gacchati āstṛtaṃ cānāstṛtaṃ kaṭhinaṃ na jānāti : paṃcabhis tu dharmaiḥ samanvāgataḥ kaṭhināstārako bhikṣur asaṃmataś ca saṃmantavya
children.translated_text: ) one who entered the later rains, one who spent the rains elsewhere, one who has returned the training. Another five also should not be appointed: one on probation (<s>pārivāsika</s>), one on original probation (<s>mūlapārivāsika</s>), one under <s>mānāpya</s> (penance), one under original <s>mānāpya</s> conduct, one who has been suspended. Another five should not be appointed: one who goes by partiality, by hatred, by delusion, by fear, and one who does not know [what constitutes] a spread and an unspread <s>kaṭhina</s>. But one endowed with five qualities should be appointed as the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader <s>bhikṣu</s> — even if not [previously] appointed, he should be appointed,

children.text: āvakāśayitavyaḥ katamaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ na cchandād gacchati na dveṣān na mohān na bhayād gacchati āstṛtānāstṛtaṃ ca kaṭhinaṃ jānāti
children.translated_text: and one [already] appointed should be given an opportunity. With which five? One who does not go by partiality, not by hatred, not by delusion, not by fear, and one who knows [what constitutes] a spread and an unspread <s>kaṭhina</s>.

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 7. Thereafter, a <s>bhikṣu</s> who will spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> is to be appointed — one endowed with five qualities. A <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader <s>bhikṣu</s> who is not appointed should not be appointed [if unqualified]; and one [already] appointed should be given an opportunity. With which five [disqualifying traits]? One who has not spent the rains, one who has broken the rains, (

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 8. evaṃ ca punaḥ saṃmantavyaḥ śayanāsanaprajñaptiṃ kṛtvā pūrvavad (

children.text: ) yāvad utsāhayitavyaḥ utsahase tvam evaṃnāmā saṃghasya kaṭhin
children.translated_text: ) up to: he should be encouraged: 'Do you, so-and-so, undertake to spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s>
— to spread it?' If he undertakes,

children.text: na vaktavyaṃ utsahed iti / tataḥ paścād ekena bhikṣuṇā jñaptiṃ kṛtvā karma kartavyam*
children.translated_text: he should not be told, 'Undertake!' Thereafter, a motion having been made by one <s>bhikṣu</s>, the formal act is to be performed.

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 8. And he should be appointed thus: having arranged the seats, as before (

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 9a. śṛṇotu bhadantāḥ saṃgha ayam evaṃnāmā kaṭhināstārako bhikṣur utsahate saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstartuṃ sacet saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ kṣametānujānīyāt saṃgho (

children.translated_text: ) that the <s>Saṃgha</s> approve so-and-so as the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader.

children.text: īti eṣā jñaptiḥ evaṃ ca karma kartavyaṃ
children.translated_text: This is the motion. And the formal act is to be performed thus:

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 9a. 'Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> hear. This <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so, the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader, undertakes to spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If it is the right time and the <s>Saṃgha</s> approves, may the <s>Saṃgha</s> consent (

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 9b.

children.text: śṛṇotu bhadantāḥ saṃghaḥ ayam evaṃnāmā kaṭhināstāraka utsahe saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstartuṃ tat saṃgha evaṃnāmānaṃ kaṭhināstārakaṃ saṃmanyeta ayam evaṃnāmā kaṭhināstarakaḥ saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstariṣyat
children.translated_text: 'Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> hear. This <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so, the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader, undertakes to spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. The <s>Saṃgha</s> approves so-and-so as the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader. This so-and-so, the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader, will spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> of the <s>Saṃgha</s>.

children.text: i yeṣām āyuṣmatāṃ kṣamate evaṃnāmānaṃ kaṭhināstārakaṃ saṃmantuṃ evaṃnāmā kaṭhināstārakaḥ saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstariṣyati te tūṣṇī
children.translated_text: If the venerable ones approve of appointing so-and-so as the <s>kaṭhina</s> (robe-frame) spreader—so-and-so the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader will spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> for the <s>saṃgha</s>—let them remain silent

children.text: na kṣamate bhāṣantāṃ saṃmataḥ saṃghena evaṃnāmā kaṭhināstārakaḥ saṃghasya kaṭhinam āstariṣyati kṣāntam anujñātaṃ saṃghena yasmāt tuṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi
children.translated_text: Those who do not approve should speak. So-and-so has been appointed by the <s>saṃgha</s> as the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader; he will spread the <s>kaṭhina</s> for the <s>saṃgha</s>. It is approved and permitted by the <s>saṃgha</s>; since they are silent, thus I hold it.

body.translated_text: <s>Kaṭhina-v</s> 9b.

body.text: Kaṭhina-v 10. tataḥ kaṭhināstārakasya bhikṣo

children.translated_text: by means of a formal motion (<s>jñapti</s>), the <s>kaṭhina</s> is to be spread (

children.text: ) śṛṇotu bhadantāḥ saṃgha idaṃ cīvaraṃ saṃghena kaṭhinārthaṃ saṃmatam ayaṃ caivaṃnāmā kaṭhināstārako bhikṣuḥ saṃmataḥ sacet saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ kṣametānujānīyāt saṃgho yat saṃghaḥ idaṃ cīvaraṃ kaṭhinārtham evaṃnāmno bhikṣor anupradadyād ity eṣā jñaptiḥ
children.translated_text: ) Let the venerable <s>saṃgha</s> listen. This robe has been approved by the <s>saṃgha</s> for the purpose of the <s>kaṭhina</s>. And this <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so has been appointed as the <s>kaṭhina</s>-spreader. If the time is appropriate for the <s>saṃgha</s>, may it approve and authorize that the <s>saṃgha</s> should hand over this robe for the purpose of the <s>kaṭhina</s> to the <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so.
